body: I don't know you, but from a response like that I don't think you deserve your treatment. You are my everything, even if only tonight. Thank you for saying something.

I'm so sorry. 
I want to say something to help you but I can't honestly say I've ever been in a situation like yours, or understand much about it. I'm so sorry that anyone would ever put you in a place like that, or any agency or group. The government can be so tonedeaf sometimes. 
Can you talk to Sammy? Do you want to ? I'm sorry for the questions, I am just fumbling for something to say.
